source: Owner-supplied reference render of the Organ section and a Master Level knob close-up (private, local only, never committed; D16). Only the numbers below are stored.
method: Median, 10th and 90th percentile of sRGB 8-bit values over small flat patches (about 50x50 px) chosen by eye on flat surface areas, away from text, LEDs and edges. 'use' is the value the Blender materials are calibrated to. Surfaces carry baked lighting, so these are appearance targets, not albedo.

panel_red.note: red chassis strip left of the organ section; use = median of four patches (126..136, 25..28, 36..39); spec token chassis_red_primary is #8E1B1F = (142, 27, 31)

panel_slate_drawbars.note: slate around the lower drawbars (darker than the upper module area; patches at 1600..1680 x 1110..1160 and 1010..1060 x 1100..1150); plate behind the caps

panel_slate.note: dark slate between modules; spec token module_slate_bg is #323D47 = (50, 61, 71)

header_silver.note: section header bar; spec token module_header_bar is #A3AFB9 = (163, 175, 185)

cap_black_top.note: black drawbar cap top face; bevel highlights reach p90

knob_side.note: knob flute sides, right of centre

knob_highlight.note: soft highlight on the knob top, upper left

ring_white.note: arc indicator ring; median is tinted by red edge pixels, p90 used

pointer.note: DRIVE knob pointer bar on the top face (light grey, not the ring white)

button_grey_base.note: grey pill button, base frame left of the pill (ORGAN button)

button_black_base.note: black pill button, base frame (ANGLE button)

button_well.note: black well around a button (thin, 2 px band)

panel_red_fine.note: red leather left of the DRIVE knob, second patch; spread shows the grain contrast

header_silver_fine.note: header bar right of the section name, clean patch; spread shows the speckle contrast

proportions.note: Ratios and sizes read by pixel counting and circle fits on the same reference (1 u = 129 reference px = knob base diameter / 0.8); no pixel data is kept.
